author: neurodeskorg
description:
Neurodesk webapps assets
	

Models and validation data for https://github.com/neurodesk/webapps, which stores source only.
Layout and naming:

<app>/ — one directory per app, named as in apps/<app> or exes/<app>; shared assets live under the app that owns them.
<app>/models/ — weights. Upstream artifacts keep their upstream filename verbatim (synthsr_v20_230130.h5); derived artifacts are <app>-<variant>.onnx (synthsr-v2.onnx, synthstrip-browser.onnx).
